title: Gca Bay Area Ras Garba - Oct 17th By Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team - Sharda Musical Grou
description: Experience the Vibrant Pulse of Navratri at GCA Bay Area Ras Garba
organizer: Gujarati Cultural Associaton Of Bay Area
long_description:
Experience the Vibrant Pulse of Navratri at GCA Bay Area Ras Garba
Join us on the 17th of October, 2026 as the Gujarati Cultural Association of the Bay Area presents the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba. This event will be a unique blend of Gujarati and Multilingual music and dance, a cultural extravaganza that brings the traditional Navratri/Dandiya celebration to life. Be prepared to groove to the rhythmic beats and mesmerizing tunes put together by the talented Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team from Sharda Musical Group.
Meet the Maestros: Aanal & Achal Anjaria
Although there's no specific artist announced for this event, the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba is meticulously curated by the Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team from Sharda Musical Group. This team is renowned for their passion and dedication towards preserving and promoting Gujarati culture through music. They are sure to deliver an unforgettable experience with their vibrant rhythms and captivating melodies that will keep you dancing all night long.
Fremont's Cultural Hotspot: Washington High School
The GCA Bay Area Ras Garba will be held at Washington High School, located at 38442 Boulevard, Fremont, CA, United States. Known for its safe and accessible location, the venue promises an enjoyable and hassle-free experience for all attendees. The area boasts a number of Indian restaurants, perfect for those looking to indulge in some authentic cuisine before or after the event. Parking is available on-site, ensuring your convenience.
Secure Your Place: Ticket Information
Don't miss out on this unique cultural experience. We offer General Admission tickets at $25.00, ensuring everyone can partake in the fun. If you're planning to come along with a group, take advantage of our special offer for groups of 8 or more, with tickets priced at just $23.00. Grab your tickets now and get ready to immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Gujarati music and dance at the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba.
